checks.detail: Signed by an Intel TDX CPU that Intel rates UpToDate, TD not in debug mode; dcap-qvl checked the chain to Intel's root. Its MRTD df4d77c857de… and RTMRs are not compared with anything: NEAR AI publishes no expected values.
The quote's report data names the key 0xfe0071895500a9755c18044948ab4f4e1a7f337e, so the key was made inside that TEE.
The quote's report data carries the fresh nonce af8c73310bd1…, so it was made for this check.
The container manifest sent with the report hashes to the quote's mr_config_id (448683dd83e5…). Nothing pins which manifest NEAR AI should run.

NVIDIA's attestation service passed 8 GH100 GPUs in confidential mode (secure boot on, debug off, measurements matched) for the same nonce as the TDX quote; its tokens verify against NVIDIA's published keys. Only that nonce ties these GPUs to the TD.
